project.name: Vortik Registry
project.description: Independent source-grounded semantic registry and deterministic research surface for selected Ethereum coordination terminology.

interaction.note: This manifest describes public capabilities that already exist. It is not an A2A Agent Card and does not advertise a live agent endpoint.

capabilities.description: Discover and verify versioned public Vortik semantic feeds without hard-coding individual feed paths.
Evaluate an ENS-style name deterministically against canonical Vortik registry and coordination-surface artifacts.

authority.note: Vortik artifacts provide an independent semantic interpretation and do not define Ethereum protocol rules, ENS authority, ownership intent, or commercial relevance.

trust_boundary.note: Any future live ENS resolution, web retrieval, MCP source ingestion, or A2A ingress requires a separate trust-boundary change before implementation.
